description: This file defines the 'StreamSupervisor' interface in Java, which provides a method to supervise a materialized stream, particularly in a WebSocket context, in the Eclipse Ditto gateway streaming service.

classes.name: StreamSupervisor
classes.description: Interface providing supervision capabilities for a materialized stream, including the 'supervise' method that manages WebSocket stream components.

methods.name: supervise
methods.description: Method to supervise a WebSocket stream component, requiring non-null arguments: the stream component, a correlation ID, and DittoHeaders. Throws NullPointerException or IllegalArgumentException based on input validity.
